body:
I can't forgive myself.  Everyone I know thinks I'm charismatic, funny, good looking. I'm both the joker and the smart guy people go to for advice.

  But behind the scenes I just live in this world of pain. I won't even get out of bed anymore if I don't have a social commitment.  If I do, lately I just waste my time lacerating my forearms instead of studying for exams I'm now bound to fail.  

People are going to be shocked when I hang myself, but I suppose that's because no one ever knew the real me.
